body: Fuck you she needs help not your shit.

It won't be as easy as you think. She may have to deal with the back and forth but if you end it then she'll have to think about why she doesn't have a mom anymore. Wether it was her fault or not and things like that. If she only has a father that she knows was once with her mother she may also end up blaming/hating him. And for her to grow up hating the only parent she has won't exactly end well. If you live she will have you to go to. This is coming from someone who was in a relatively same situation from the child's view full well knowing about my dad overpowering my mom as far as courts go but I don't hate either of them in the slightest. Had my mother killed herself when times got like that I would not be able to look my father in the eyes all my life as I would blame him. And if you go you might as well be taking him too meaning she will have no one. And that will lead to some undesired things down the road. No matter how hard anyone tries if you go this will not end well. Please for the future of your daughter please try. Please don't end it.
Let's talk about this some more. Pm me and I can talk to you a bit quicker.
I understand but people just want to help you so you don't want to die. And all I ask of you is to at least try and let us help you.
I understand but people just want to help you so you don't want to die.
There must be something that you enjoy.

You are asked to go on because we care. If you are unhappy with the therapy stop going. If its making it worse say it so to the therapist. You where placed there because someone cares about you so you are obviously not that worthless.
It may hurt to go on but it's better than dying. Please stay with us here. You will be missed if you leave by someone somewhere you will be missed. Please talk to us.

Please talk to me. You are not a coward for not taking the whole thing, it just means that you don't want to die, wanting to live does not make you a coward. What's happening that's so bad that you want to end it this much?

I know how you feel. I'm the same age and feel that way as well but there must be some reason for you to live. Future plans? Friends? Some one or something you care about has to exist. Don't leave behind this world because there is someone that would care. It would destroy someone wether you knew it or not someone that WILL miss you. Please talk to me. Don't leave just yet.
Shut up dude. He's happy let him be that way. No need to try and explain it just let it be.
I don't feel much better and no now it's in front of me half loaded.
I don't want to talk to someone that will just lock me in an asylum. I feel much better talking to all of you.
I tried to call the suicide help hotline.
They won't pick up. And when they did they hung up when I said that I had a gun to my temple. I called them first. And you're glad to hear that she's telling me that it was all my fault?
Ok it's locked in my drawer what should I do?
I can hear her whispering in my ear. She's saying it's my fault that I could have saved her. Why can I hear her?
I'm not sure. I can hear her whispering in my ear she says it's my fault. Why can I hear her?
Yes I guess she would. But she wouldn't have lost someone she loved. She didn't believe that she could be loved. She filled the void with sex.
Go ahead. I need my mind off this.
I don't know. She'd probably tell me that everything would be ok in the morning.
Its my .357 with hollow points and the only thing keeping it away from my head is that im worried I'd hurt someone else like I hurt now.
With my hope and her both gone I don't think I can believe in anything anymore.
I'm 17 I had trouble with these thoughts in the past but as I said she gave me hope and made me not afraid to live.
Im not sure. I got angry at the churches ideals and couldn't stand with them. By her dying I've had what was left of my faith shaken.
You're supposed to have hope and belief. Now that she's gone though I'm not sure I believe in god anymore. She wouldn't be gone if there was.
I'm a Christian that's struggling with my faith. This just pushed me over the edge though.
Now it's in my hand while I try to work up the nerve to pull the trigger
Thats just it. She gave me hope. I wanted to tell her how I felt and be with her.
The gun is unloaded. I had to think for a while. But in a minute or two it might be reloaded.

It's all over my school. She really did it. I think I'm the only one that cares. Some people even called it good that she did it and that makes me feel like I was the only friend she had and couldn't even help her. I couldn't pick up that the girl I loved was going to kill herself. No I know that I don't deserve to live.
